coverage: Two live WebContentsViews in one hidden Electron window and one shared in-memory session. Uses the production routeProtectionRequest helper, LocalProtectionEngine, and ProtectionPageContextStore. Fixture scripts targeting ads.intoponet.test and track.intoponet.test were allowed for paused site A and canceled before reaching the local server for protected site B.
limitations: This harness does not boot the full Intoponet main process or exercise the renderer shield controls and protection IPC persistence.
It does not test redirect chains, failed navigation rollback, service-worker requests without a WebContents ID, certificates, or external network requests.
The hidden-window probe verifies Chromium request interception and page execution, not visible compositing or accessibility behavior.
